name: Make the ask limits agree with each other
why: The real prompt states different ask limits for the same thing (any slot 2 vs 3; name 2 vs 3; product 4 vs 5). IndiaMART's quality matrix grades probing a parameter more than 1+2 times as fatal looping behaviour, so the limits have to agree. This edit makes each pair agree on the more specific statement.
risk: It changes no intended behaviour, but a model that was following the looser limit will now stop a little sooner, so slightly less name or product detail may be captured. Verbatim loops are rare in the real calls (1.7% reach three repeats; a lower bound), so the expected gain is small and mostly protects against fatal looping.
